data.long_meaning: In Arabic, the name Naiim is derived from the Arabic word ‘na’imah’ which means 'pleasant, delightful, given as a gift'. It is a name that symbolizes generosity and kindness. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, ‘Give gifts to those whom you love, and those who love you, and those who are neutral to you.' (Bukhari)
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to give generously and spread kindness.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naiim total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
